Module : QuaternionManipulator¶

Module overview¶

This module implements the class QuaternionManipulator.QuaternionManipulator

  • This class is used by the function main.

  • Note that only one method of the class is public and that is QuaternionManipulator.QuaternionManipulator.run()

 74    def _set_values_from_command_line_args(self) :
 75
 76        # Set values based on the arguments which were passed in from the command line.
 77
 78        self.verbose_operation   = sys.argv[1]
 79        self.operation_type      = sys.argv[2]
 80        self.axis_x              = float(sys.argv[3])
 81        self.axis_y              = float(sys.argv[4])
 82        self.axis_z              = float(sys.argv[5])
 83        self.angle_rotation_full = float(sys.argv[6])
 84        self.vector_x            = float(sys.argv[7])
 85        self.vector_y            = float(sys.argv[8])
 86        self.vector_z            = float(sys.argv[9])
 87
 88        # Set up the appropriate values for the rotation.
 89
 90        self.quaternion_axis_rotation = np.quaternion(0, self.axis_x,   self.axis_y,   self.axis_z)
 91        self.quaternion_to_rotate     = np.quaternion(0, self.vector_x, self.vector_y, self.vector_z)
 92
 93
 94    def _preMultiplyVectorUsingQuaternion(self) :
 95
 96        nameMethod     = "preMultiplyVectorUsingQuaternion"
 97
 98        operation_type = "partial_multiplication"
 99
100
101        result = subprocess.run(
102            [
103             GlobalSettings.utility_quaternion_rotation,
104             str(self.verbose_operation),
105             operation_type,
106             str(self.quaternion_to_rotate.x),
107             str(self.quaternion_to_rotate.y),
108             str(self.quaternion_to_rotate.z),
109             str(math.radians(self.angle_rotation)),
110             str(self.quaternion_axis_rotation.x),
111             str(self.quaternion_axis_rotation.y),
112             str(self.quaternion_axis_rotation.z)
113            ],
114            capture_output=True,
115            text=True
116        )
117
118        # Convert the string into a list of strings, breaking the original string at "," symbols.
119
120        string_quaternion = (result.stdout).split(",")
121
122        self.quaternion_pre_multiply.w = float(string_quaternion[0])
123        self.quaternion_pre_multiply.x = float(string_quaternion[1])
124        self.quaternion_pre_multiply.y = float(string_quaternion[2])
125        self.quaternion_pre_multiply.z = float(string_quaternion[3])
126
127        # print(result.stdout)
128        # print(result.stderr)
129        # print(result.returncode)
130
131        return self.quaternion_pre_multiply
132
133

178    def _update_plotting_agent(self) :
179

182

205

215    def _update_loop_parameters(self) :
216
217        self.counter_loop   += 1
218        angle_rotation_next  = (self.counter_loop * self.angle_rotation_increment) + self.angle_rotation_start
219
220        # The quaternionic rotation might stop, but the view can still keep spinning around.
221        #
222        # Check for this.
223
224        if angle_rotation_next <= self.angle_rotation_full :
225
226            self.angle_rotation = angle_rotation_next
227
228        self.azimuth_view = (self.counter_loop * self.azimuth_view_increment) + self.azimuth_view_start
229
230
231    def _generate_plots_display_diagnostics(self) :
232
233        nameMethod = "VectorManipulator::_generate_plots_display_diagnostics"
234
235
236        print(">>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>")
237        print(nameMethod + f" : self.counter_loop = {self.counter_loop:d}")
238        print(">>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>")
239        print(f"Azimuth view = {self.azimuth_view:f}")
240

242    # Invoked by : VectorManipulator::run
243
244    def _generate_plots(self) :
245
246        nameMethod         = "VectorManipulator::_generate_plots"
247
248
249        print(nameMethod + " : Enter")
250
251        while self.azimuth_view <= 720 :
252
253            self._generate_plots_display_diagnostics()
254
255            filename = f"rotation-{self.counter_loop:04d}.png"
256
257            self._perform_quaternion_operations()
258
259            self._update_plotting_agent()
260            self._generate_plot(filename)
261
262            self._update_loop_parameters()
263
264            print("<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<")
265            print()
266
267        print(nameMethod + " : Exit")

    actor User

    participant QM as QuaternionManipulator

    participant PA as PlottingAgent

    activate QM

    QM->>QM: _generate_plots()

    loop while azimuth_view <= 720

        QM->>QM: _generate_plots_display_diagnostics()

        QM->>QM: _perform_quaternion_operations()

        QM->>EXE: partial_multiplication(...)
        activate EXE
        EXE-->>QM: quaternion_pre_multiply
        deactivate EXE

        QM->>EXE: rotation(...)
        activate EXE
        EXE-->>QM: quaternion_rotated
        deactivate EXE

        QM->>QM: _update_plotting_agent()

        QM->>PA: set_angle_rotation(angle)
        activate PA
        PA-->>QM:
        deactivate PA

        QM->>PA: set_quaternions(q, v, qv, v')
        activate PA
        PA-->>QM:
        deactivate PA

        QM->>PA: set_view(azimuth, elevation)
        activate PA
        PA-->>QM:
        deactivate PA

        QM->>PA: generate_plot(filename)
        activate PA
        PA-->>QM: plot saved
        deactivate PA

        QM->>QM: _update_loop_parameters()

    end
